name: AP Physics 2
note: Unit and topic structure follows the College Board AP Physics 2 course framework (2024 revision). Titles and descriptions are written in Scorpio's own words; they are not College Board text.

units.title: Thermodynamics
units.summary: Temperature, gases, heat transfer, the first and second laws and entropy.

topics.title: Kinetic theory of temperature and pressure
topics.summary: Linking temperature to the average kinetic energy of particles and pressure to their collisions with walls.

topics.title: The ideal gas law
topics.summary: Relating pressure, volume, temperature and amount of gas, and reading PV diagrams.

topics.title: Thermal energy transfer and equilibrium
topics.summary: Heating by conduction, convection and radiation, and why objects in contact reach one temperature.

topics.title: The first law of thermodynamics
topics.summary: Energy conservation for a gas: internal energy changes through heating and work in isothermal, isobaric, isochoric and adiabatic processes.

topics.title: Specific heat and thermal conductivity
topics.summary: How much energy a temperature change takes for a material, and how fast energy flows through it.

topics.title: Entropy and the second law of thermodynamics
topics.summary: Why energy spreads out, the direction of spontaneous processes and limits on converting heating into work.

units.title: Electric force, field and potential
units.summary: Charge, Coulomb's law, electric fields, potential energy, potential and capacitors.

topics.title: Electric charge and electric force
topics.summary: Two kinds of charge and the inverse-square force between point charges.

topics.title: Conservation of electric charge and charging
topics.summary: Charging by friction, contact and induction; conductors, insulators and grounding.

topics.title: Electric fields
topics.summary: Field as force per unit charge: field vectors and lines for point charges, plates and conductors.

topics.title: Electric potential energy
topics.summary: Energy stored in a system of charges and how it changes as charges move.

topics.title: Electric potential
topics.summary: Potential energy per unit charge, equipotential lines and their link to the field.

topics.title: Capacitors
topics.summary: Parallel-plate capacitors: capacitance, charge, field, stored energy and dielectrics.

topics.title: Conservation of electric energy
topics.summary: Energy bar charts and conservation for charges moving through a potential difference.

units.title: Electric circuits
units.summary: Current, resistance, power, series and parallel circuits, Kirchhoff's rules and RC circuits.

topics.title: Electric current
topics.summary: Rate of charge flow, its direction by convention and what drives it.

topics.title: Simple circuits
topics.summary: Closed loops, circuit diagrams and the roles of batteries, wires, switches and loads.

topics.title: Resistance, resistivity and Ohm's law
topics.summary: What sets a wire's resistance, and the current through ohmic and non-ohmic elements.

topics.title: Electric power
topics.summary: The rate at which circuit elements transfer energy, and comparing bulb brightness.

topics.title: Compound direct current circuits
topics.summary: Equivalent resistance for series and parallel combinations, ammeters, voltmeters and internal resistance.

topics.title: Kirchhoff's loop rule
topics.summary: Energy conservation around any closed loop of a circuit.

topics.title: Kirchhoff's junction rule
topics.summary: Charge conservation where branches of a circuit meet.

topics.title: Resistor-capacitor (RC) circuits
topics.summary: Charging and discharging a capacitor through a resistor: initial, steady-state and time-constant behaviour.

units.title: Magnetism and electromagnetism
units.summary: Magnetic fields, forces on moving charges and currents, and induction.

topics.title: Magnetic fields
topics.summary: Fields of permanent magnets and Earth, dipoles and how materials respond to a field.

topics.title: Magnetism and moving charges
topics.summary: The force on a charge moving through a field, circular paths and the field a moving charge makes.

topics.title: Magnetism and current-carrying wires
topics.summary: The field around a long wire and forces on and between wires that carry current.

topics.title: Electromagnetic induction and Faraday's law
topics.summary: Changing magnetic flux, induced emf and Lenz's law for the direction of the induced current.

units.title: Geometric optics
units.summary: Reflection, refraction and the images formed by mirrors and lenses.

topics.title: Reflection
topics.summary: The law of reflection, specular and diffuse reflection and plane-mirror images.

topics.title: Images formed by mirrors
topics.summary: Ray diagrams and the mirror equation for concave and convex mirrors; real and virtual images.

topics.title: Refraction
topics.summary: Index of refraction, Snell's law, total internal reflection and the critical angle.

topics.title: Images formed by lenses
topics.summary: Ray diagrams and the thin-lens equation for converging and diverging lenses; magnification.

units.title: Waves, sound and physical optics
units.summary: Wave properties, standing waves, the Doppler effect, interference and diffraction.

topics.title: Properties of wave pulses and waves
topics.summary: Transverse and longitudinal waves, amplitude, and what sets a wave's speed in a medium.

topics.title: Periodic waves
topics.summary: Wavelength, frequency, period and the relation v = f times wavelength; reading wave graphs.

topics.title: Boundary behaviour of waves and polarization
topics.summary: Reflection and transmission at boundaries, inverted pulses and polarized light.

topics.title: Electromagnetic waves
topics.summary: Light as a transverse wave of fields, the spectrum and the speed of light.

topics.title: The Doppler effect
topics.summary: Shifts in observed frequency when a source or observer moves.

topics.title: Wave interference and standing waves
topics.summary: Superposition, beats, nodes and antinodes, and harmonics on strings and in pipes.

topics.title: Diffraction
topics.summary: Spreading of waves through openings and around obstacles; single-slit patterns.

topics.title: Double-slit interference and diffraction gratings
topics.summary: Path difference, bright and dark fringes and how slit spacing and wavelength set the pattern.

topics.title: Thin-film interference
topics.summary: Phase changes on reflection and the colours of soap films and coatings.

units.title: Modern physics
units.summary: Quantum ideas, atomic models, photons, and nuclear physics.

topics.title: Quantum theory and wave-particle duality
topics.summary: Photons, the de Broglie wavelength and when wave or particle models apply.

topics.title: The Bohr model of atomic structure
topics.summary: Quantized energy levels in hydrogen and transitions between them.

topics.title: Emission and absorption spectra
topics.summary: Spectral lines as energy differences between levels; identifying elements.

topics.title: Blackbody radiation
topics.summary: How the spectrum and power radiated by a hot object depend on its temperature.

topics.title: The photoelectric effect
topics.summary: Threshold frequency, work function and the energy of ejected electrons.

topics.title: Compton scattering
topics.summary: Photon momentum and the wavelength shift when a photon scatters from an electron.

topics.title: Fission, fusion and nuclear decay
topics.summary: Mass-energy equivalence, binding energy and conservation in nuclear reactions.

topics.title: Types of radioactive decay
topics.summary: Alpha, beta and gamma decay, half-life and decay curves.
